records.title: 10-K
records.text: Total operating revenues decreased $5.2 billion, or 59%, during 2020 compared to the same period in 2019.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: On a consolidated basis, passenger revenue for 2020 decreased by $5.1 billion, or 63%, on a 44% decrease in capacity, and a 29 point decrease in load factor.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Compared to the same quarters in the prior year, our flown capacity was down 75% in Q2, down 55% in Q3 and down 42% in Q4, resulting in full year capacity that was 44% below 2019 levels.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: As a result, our non-fuel operating expenses, excluding the Payroll Support Program grant wage offset and special items, declined 22% for the year.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Net cash used in operating activities was $234 million in 2020 compared to net cash provided of $1.7 billion in 2019.
